segments.name: Digital fan engagement services
segments.description: Operates the Faning digital fan engagement platform centered on Korean entertainment and K-pop for global fans.
segments.evidence: As of December 31, 2025, the Company has determined that it operates in a single reportable segment focused on digital fan engagement services .

revenueModel.text: Users pay for Vote Packages, Boosts and tiered subscriptions, while advertisers pay for targeted display advertisements and sponsored content.
revenueModel.evidence: Users purchase Vote Packages to participate in community activities and Boosts—paid enhancements that increase the visibility and impact of their support for specific content or artists.

changes.text: In 2024, the Company sold its subsidiaries FNS Co. Ltd, Marin Island Co. Ltd and Hanryu Bank Co. Ltd, which were classified as discontinued operations.
changes.evidence: Hanryu Bank Co. Ltd ("HBC") sold 100 % of its shares in FNS Co. Ltd for $ 733 and Marin Island Co. Ltd for $ 367 on November 5, 2024, to improve its financial structure.
